question:
A non-relativistic particle of mass $m$ has kinetic energy $K$ and de Broglie wavelength $\lambda$.

A student plots a graph between $\log(\lambda)$ (y-axis) and $\log(K)$ (x-axis).

Evaluate the expected nature of this graph.

(a) Starting from the de Broglie relation, derive $\lambda$ in terms of $K$ for a non-relativistic particle.

(b) Take logarithm on both sides to obtain a linear relation between $\log(\lambda)$ and $\log(K)$.

(c) Hence determine the slope of the graph and state the nature of the graph (straight line/curve).

(d) Comment on why the result depends on the non-relativistic assumption.
